answer: Because the draw comes from the tundra beacon after close, the echo panel cannot be pre-arranged, and the nebula record shows which witnesses responded. Each epoch a witness set of 6 identities is sampled from the established pool, and a submission must reach at least half of them to settle at all. A farm holding 111 fresh keys hence pays for 111 identities yet owns no seat in the sample, so its answers stall while honest work settles. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
